items.html: *And we shall now explain the matter of the second Ibur, for the need of the Mochin of birth. And with this will be understood what is said in the portion Acharei Mot, page 65, column 2, line 24, and this is its language: 'And Ima nursed two sons, and she became pregnant from them, and afterward brought them forth, etc.' Now, this language is very difficult to comprehend, for he should have said, 'And she became pregnant from them at first, and afterward she nursed them,' for the Ibur precedes the nursing. And furthermore it implies that after they were literally actual sons, she returned and became pregnant from them. And all this must be understood.
